messages:
Kai (People Ops): Exception request: candidate Arjun Rao for Principal Data Engineer. Manager requests compband P3 (guideline P2) plus $25k sign-on split and an early start of 2026-04-01. Need approvals and benefits effective date clarified.
June (Hiring Mgr): Strong hire. P3 aligns with cross-team impact. 4/1 start important for project ramp.
Omar (Recruiter): Candidate can give 2 week notice; 4/1 looks tight but possible. Asked whether sign-on is 12mo retention or 6mo.
Tess (Compben): Policy note: sign-ons >$20k need VP sign-off. Provide total comp breakdown and retention terms. Benefits effective: usually first of month after start unless payroll allows same-day.
Kai (People Ops): Proposed package:
```
base: $220,000
bonus target: $30,000
sign-on: $25,000 (12.5k immediate, 12.5k at 6 months contingent on employment)
equity: $160,000 (4yr)
total OTE year1: $435,000
```
Marco (Finance): Budget ok if split 12.5/12.5 with retention clause. Need payroll GL codes and note on timing. Also confirm immediate payment falls into next payroll cycle after start.
June (Hiring Mgr): Manager will own 6mo check-in. 12.5/12.5 acceptable. Please ensure retention goals documented.
Tess (Compben): Requesting leveling justification for P3 (org comp ratio, market data). Also will draft offer language: 6-month conditional payment and benefits effective date.
offer-bot: Offer GH-99811 drafted. Routing people-ops -> compben -> finance -> vp-people.
Kai (People Ops): Tagging @Ruth for P3 and sign-on >20k approval. Ruth?
Ruth (VP People): Reviewed docs in GH. Approving P3 exception and $25k sign-on with 12.5k immediate + 12.5k at 6 months conditioned on continued employment and manager verification. Require manager to add 6mo objectives to onboarding plan. Approving now.
Marco (Finance): Finance confirms. Will process immediate 12.5k on first payroll after start; deferred 12.5k after HR verifies 6 months. Provide payroll code to People Ops.
Tess (Compben): Offer language updated, benefits effective: first payroll date after start (candidate informed). Will finalize offer letter.
Omar (Recruiter): Candidate accepted verbally under these terms. Sending signed offer now.
offer-bot: Offer GH-99811 status -> accepted.
Kai (People Ops): Final tasks: send benefits packet, set benefits effective per compben, add 6mo retention reminder on manager calendar, and save approval doc to payroll folder. Closing thread once benefits packet sent. Thanks all :rocket:
